latency.setup: GPT-2 small fp16, batch 1, prompt 9 tokens, 6 trials x 100 decode steps (10 warmup each), CUDA events, trial order alternated

memory.setup: 32 GPT-2 sequences, prompt 9 tokens + 50 decode steps = 59 tokens each, page_size 16
memory.note: paged = bytes of pages owned by live sequences; the pool itself is reserved up front. DynamicCache also grows with the sequence, so the saving is against static pre-allocation.

capacity.setup: one KV budget = a 512-page pool (302.0 MB K+V); every sequence runs to 59 tokens
capacity.method: paged: sequences admitted until the allocator raised MemoryError; static: budget divided by the measured bytes of one StaticCache(max_cache_len=512)

kernels.setup: 2048 tokens, fp16, random page order; gather = all 12 layers x 12 heads x 64, scatter = one layer
kernels.note: GB/s counts bytes read + written; the torch device-to-device copy of the same bytes is the measured ceiling on this GPU

allocator.setup: 500 cycles x 16 sequences x 8 pages, alloc then free, best of 5, called from Python
